PCM codec: decoder for all interleaved PCM variants plus encoder.

Decoder ports symphonia-codec-pcm/src/lib.rs: the 20 interleaved variants (S8/S16LE/BE/S24LE/BE/S32LE/BE, U8/U16/U24/U32 LE/BE, F32/F64 LE/BE, A-law, mu-law), A-law/mu-law transfer functions (adapted from Sun's g711.c, unrestricted-use license, see below), and the bits-per-sample/bits-per-coded-sample shift validation. Planar variants parse but decode in the filter phase.

The encoder (encodePcm, law encoders) is new work: Symphonia has no encoders. Law encoding maps each sample to the code whose decoded representative is nearest (precomputed 64 KiB LUT), which guarantees encode(decode(b)) == b for all 256 codes.

A-law and mu-law decode tables (alawToLinear, mulawToLinear) are adaptations of alaw2linear and ulaw2linear from g711.c by Sun Microsystems, Inc., provided for unrestricted use. Sun source code is provided as-is with no warranties of any kind.
